name: Stow
subtitle: A calmer YouTube, with no Shorts.

apps.name: Stow
apps.subtitle: A calmer YouTube, with no Shorts.
apps.localizedDescription: Plays and downloads the videos your Mac picks, plus YouTube's Home and Subscriptions and search, with no Shorts. Pairs with the Stow Mac app.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Stow shows when a new version is out: Settings › About, or the banner on Home, then Update in SideStore.
- Upload dates on search results and channel pages, said the way YouTube says them ("3 days ago", "1 year ago").
First iPhone version. Not yet tested on a real iPhone: install it with SideStore or AltStore from ios/source.json, then pair it from Phone › Pair a Phone on the Mac.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Stow uses the camera to scan the pairing code on your Mac.
